pages.text: A head in it uses no saline. It does not extend the link. Fill it by bottle or bucket.

Each second it refills a docked head's saline, moves up to 10 kFE of charge and uses 100 FE; every 10 s it mends a point of glass.$(br)To dock, use it with your head in the Head Satchel; again to take it out. As the jar: use it, then Swap.
